findings.summary: Memoize the materialized asset document by source. Five call sites ask different questions of the same container, over assets reaching ten megabytes.

Use the LoweringContext return-object, property-initializer and variable-initializer helpers in the skeleton lowerer, as the sibling geospatial lowerer does. Contract-assertion path; emitted output unchanged.
Return the opaque engine value rather than rebuilding it field by field.

Correct three statements this branch falsified: the activation comment's count of derived defines, require_geometry_target_count's list of families, and the emitted BBLITE_GEOMETRY_TASK_FAMILIES define's spacing.
Build one geometry colour-target builder per backend. The node arm is a third near-verbatim copy of the classes-to-targets loop and a strict subset of the two material-family copies.
Compose a node mesh block once per mesh per frame rather than once per pass. Cost scales as meshes times tasks times lights.
Fold node_geometry_variants into node_variants behind a task selector, collapsing NodeViewRows, node_slot_rows, node_geometry_slot and node_slot_is_geometry.
Have identifierIsRebound consult the module planner's memoized rebound-symbol set instead of rescanning per identifier.
Consolidate nullableResourceKind's hand-written name rows into a table.
